page.notes: Running head: the last word "NATVRÆ" is partly worn and marked [?]. Line 1 of the page is cut at the top, so the paragraph continues from the previous page (cont="true"). The text "dicentia" has a small mark over the "i" and a reference symbol in the left margin beside it; I could not read a letter or note text for it, so I did not write a note. "eu" in "Idcirco si eu uomitu" is hard to read and is marked [?]. "p inferiora" has a superscript mark over the p, possibly an abbreviation for per, copied as printed. Printed "uicefimo" has long s and is transcribed as "uicesimo". The word "symptomata" and "malignas" are split across lines without a visible hyphen, so they are written whole. Printed "sanguis" appears as "fanguis"; read as sanguis.
